class.name: NNBTConditionLeaf
class.brief_description: Base class for condition leaves that should return [code]SUCCESS[/code] or [code]FAILURE[/code].
class.description: A condition leaf answers a yes/no question about the world and is expected to return [code]SUCCESS[/code] or [code]FAILURE[/code] from its [method NNBTTaskNodes.on_tick] override. If a condition leaf returns [code]RUNNING[/code], the result is returned unchanged and a single engine error is reported per node instance stating that condition leaves should return [code]SUCCESS[/code] or [code]FAILURE[/code]. The result is never coerced.
